_note: Scripted Risk flags for ambiguous-clauses-01 (ticket 07, PRD criterion 11). Clauses 3 and 4 are each written to support two readings and come back as Ambiguous clauses; clause 4's comes back at Know this, which Review must correct to Negotiate. Clause 5 is an ordinary Know this flag. Every Source sentence is in the document, and no text picks a reading.

riskFlags.title: When the delivery period starts
riskFlags.says: Supplier delivers within ten days of the order or payment. The clause does not say which of the two starts the ten days.
sourceSentences: 3. Delivery. Supplier will deliver the goods within ten days of the order or payment.
readings: The ten days run from the order or from payment, whichever comes first.
The ten days run from the order or from payment, whichever comes later.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Supplier will deliver the goods within ten days of the date Buyer places the order.

riskFlags.title: Which costs the Rs. 5,000 threshold covers
riskFlags.says: Buyer reimburses Supplier's travel and accommodation costs over Rs. 5,000. The clause does not say whether the Rs. 5,000 applies to both kinds of cost or to accommodation only.
sourceSentences: 4. Expenses. Buyer will reimburse Supplier's travel and accommodation costs over Rs. 5,000.
readings: Buyer reimburses only the part of Supplier's travel and accommodation costs, taken together, that is over Rs. 5,000.
Buyer reimburses all of Supplier's travel costs, and only the part of its accommodation costs that is over Rs. 5,000.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Buyer will reimburse only the part of Supplier's travel and accommodation costs, taken together, that is over Rs. 5,000.

riskFlags.title: Price reduction for late delivery
riskFlags.says: For each week the goods are late, Supplier reduces the price by Rs. 2,000.
riskFlags.judgment: No limit on the total reduction appears in the document.
sourceSentences: 5. Late delivery. For each week the goods are late, Supplier will reduce the price by Rs. 2,000.
riskFlags.counterOffer: For each week or part of a week the goods are late, Supplier will reduce the price by Rs. 2,000.
